text: Requiring data scientists to stake a cryptocurrency on their own predictions converts private confidence into a public signal, which enables the fund to select the optimal model and improve fund performance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: The staking process, in turn, enables Numerai to choose the optimal model and in the process improve the performance of its hedge fund.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: describes Numerai's use of the Numeraire token as a staking mechanism
